items.title: China expands its manufacturing role for biopharma’s new drugs
items.summary: Biopharma firms are increasingly choosing to manufacture their newer FDA-approved innovator and biosimilar products at facilities in China.

items.title: Aptar Pharma and Macquarie University partner on drug delivery project
items.summary: Aptar and Macquarie's collaboration will evaluate how factors, including how formulation variables influence drug delivery with Aptar’s dry powder inhaler platform.

items.title: FDA commissioner nominee affirms MMR vaccine safety despite Trump’s claims
items.summary: Despite Dr Heidi Overton’s declaration, senators questioned whether the commissioner-elect would challenge erroneous statements from president Trump.

items.title: Roche and Earendil forge $1.5bn bispecific discovery deal
items.summary: Roche joins Sanofi on the list of big pharma companies that are betting on Earendil’s AI-powered drug discovery platform.

items.title: Amberstone and Henlius agree to develop solid-tumour T-cell engagers
items.summary: Amberstone Biosciences has signed a partnership and licence agreement with Shanghai Henlius Biotech for conditionally activated T-cell engager candidates to treat solid tumours.
